kind: rejected integration hypothesis and isolated link diagnostic; no source restoration
hypothesis: bios_msg_base aliases sysinit_msg_base because the SYSINIT table contains the CPU and A20 texts consumed by MSINIT.

rejection.reason: The target error-report instruction uses BIOS_CODE offset 2db4h, while the identified SYSINIT message table begins at file offset f31ah. No final segment/layout proof equates those addresses. A same-address source alias would therefore assert an unsupported and likely false segment ownership.
rejection.diagnostic_observation: The temporary alias reduced the no-a20stub external set from 35 to 34, but link satisfaction alone is not target-layout proof. The project source and diagnostic placeholder were both reverted.

limitations: bios_msg_base, bios_msg_1, bios_msg_2, bios_msg_3, EC35_FLAG and the other shared-provider symbols remain unrecovered.
No final IO.SYS layout, relocation, or whole-file byte equality is claimed.
